user_problem: Maintainers need to find uncategorized, multiply categorized, or weakly defined items in a supplied taxonomy.
unique_output: Assignment/definition coverage report for supplied items and allowed category definitions: unassigned items, conflicting memberships, weak definitions and unresolved reviewer questions. Do not validate parent graphs; taxonomy-structure-check owns graph validation.
test_case: Given category definitions and item assignments, preserve one unassigned item, one exclusivity conflict and one self-referential definition; do not invent missing assignments.
overlap_to_check: Keyword research, content planning, and global ranking tools.
specific_guardrail: Use supplied evidence and explicit constraints only; missing authority and unknown facts stay unresolved.
